body: Surfaced in the T-84..T-96 final whole-branch review. web/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx handleCurrencySave sends initials from possibly-unresolved state; if getSettings() fails or the user saves currency before it resolves, initials="" is a real value post-T-87 and clears the override server-side. Exact web analogue of the Android T-97. Not a regression (web always sent both keys). Fix: omit the initials key from the updateSettings payload on a currency-only save when the preload has not resolved (server now treats an absent key as leave-unchanged, T-87). Files: web/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx (+ test). Cross-ref: T-97, T-87.
title: Web: currency save can clobber initials when the settings preload failed — mirror of T-97
